translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: MAK
book.title: MAK Mak ere bas rasem tuma yenbo.

content: Jisas ere etep wom. God eteri ake eisau ere yaper tete nenbe.
Jisas ere God eteri ake eisau mesginin yim, eri anepoi tame wuri ere erne etep wom. Tuma wusoube tame, gwote ake, God eteri ake e ake yenbowai. Ake eme papek kerem, pape yenbowai.

Jisas ere awosein etep wom. Kem gwote ake eisau laye. Kiyi eme gwote ake kerem, eme pape peten yopen yawom. Yuri ete pape eme akeite pape luke beke kip te. Eme akei beran petewarte nenbe. Ere etep wom.
Jisas ere wom. Nogwape wos yaper tete nenbe.
Jisas ere Oliv kowke yawen sin God eteri ake eisau lam. Etek simenem, Pita, Jems, Jon, Andru etemwou eme eterken yawen temenem. Temenem, eme erne wolam.
Ne woye, tame eme God eri ake eisau berate. Be yabelke eme etep tete? Be wos nema kiyi lan abote, eme God eri ake ek berate? Ne nemne wusoute.
Ere emne etep wom. Kem eisa eisa. Tame wuri ere kemne mane yikwokwote.
Nogwape tame eme yuri yan areri sigke wote. Eme tuma yikwokwon etep wote. An Krais, God ere ane won yam tame. Nogwape tatame eme emri yikwokwobe tuma worwor mette nenbe.

Yuri kem late, tatame eme ei naite. Mekinke tetan tatame, genek tetan tatame eme ei naite. Kem etep mette, kem mane ep abo ep abote. E nowsel yaper tete yabel berai. Nowsel yaper tete yabel ere yurik tete.

Yuri kom wuriri tatame eme akeite komri tatame etemken ei naite. Keryen wuri eri wakseken eme akeite keryen eri wakseken eme etep ei naite. Nina kom komke yate nenbe. Tatame eme nakwoi meig site nenbe. Ete wos e ta te yen warwite tasen metbe muskap. Yuri yaper wos nogwape etepke tete nenbe.

Kem eisa eisa. Kau tame eme kemne pap wayen tuma namdete nenbe. Eme kemne God eteri ake etek paku pete nenbe. Kem met. Kem areri anepoi tame, eke eme kemne apeilake etemri kaunsil etemri bitimik won tetete nenbe. Etep tetek, kem areri tuma yenbo emne etek wusoute.
God eri tuma akei komri komri tatame eme akei kiyi mettek, yuri nowsel yaper tete yabel ek tete.

Yuri eme kemne tuma namdete panen yite, kem mane akte. Kem mane etep abote. O, nema be tumake awosein wote? Ete yabel God ere kemne tuma peterate, kem ete tuma awosein wote. Kerem wote tuma e keremri tuma berai. God Eteri Wou ere kemne gulelete, kem tuma awosein kuyese wote.

Tame eme emri lakemase emken akeite tameken emne won yite, eme lakemase emne tuma namden pen sate nenbe. Ane eme yen emne etepwou nente. Yen eme anenawo emne magel taite, emne akeite tamene won yite, eme emne pen sate nenbe.
Kem ane kenawaike abote, eke tatame nogwape eme kemne pap wayete nenbe. Etek yaper tete yabel omote, ane som abobe tatame etemwou eme noub som temente nenbe.
Wos yaperwai tete nenbe.

Jisas ere etep wom. Yuri kem late, tame wuri ere wos yaperwai God eteri akek raste nenbe. Kem etep late, kem Judia distrikke tetan tatame kem kowke amen yin tete. Kem gwote siglou labe tatame, tuma somo kem noub abote.

Tame ere ake makle ege simente wote, ere ete wos yaper late, ere agetage amen yite. Ere ake mane wurin be wos be wos mane pette. Ere epitage kuyese beke kip pet, eke ere mane wurin pette, ere yaper tete wurken.

Tame ere nowke temente wote, ere ete wos yaper late, ere agetage amen yite. Ere eri akek mane wurin eri tame oub mane pette. Eri tame oub ere epitage beke kip pet, eke ere mane wurin pette, ere yaper tete wurken.
Ete yabel an yenken ta, yen muk newobe ta emne abote. Eme kuyese agetage beke kip ame.
Ete wos ere mou tete yabelke tete wote, kem mapeke ame? Kem God erne tuma wolate, ete wos yaper ere mou tibe yabelke mane tete.
Ete yabel wos yaper nogwapewai tete nenbe. Kiyi etepkap wos yaper beke te. Kiyisape God ere nowsel seikin yam, gwopte kir, etepkap wos yaper beke temen. Ete wos yaper omote, sene etepkap beke kip te.
Ete yabel God ere borke beke regte wom, akei tatame eme pauk saiwote wom. Eke God ere eter kenem tatame etemne abom, yuri ere ete yabel borke regte.
Ete yabel tatame eme kemne etep wote. Ek la. Gwo Krais. Etep wote, emri tuma kem mane worwor mette. Emri wote tuma e me yikwokwobe tuma.

Nogwape tame eme yan kemne tuma yikwokwon etep wote. An Krais, an God eteri tuma wusoube tame. Eme yate, eme rigrabe nente, eme etep abote. An rigrabe nente, God eri kenawaike abobe tatame eme ari yikwokwobe tuma worwor mette. Etep abote, God erne kenawaike abobe tatame eme emri tuma worwor mette.
Kem eisa eisa. Yuri tete wos an kemne kiyi wusouye.
Tatame Etemne Lan Yeirim Tame ere yuri yate.
Ete yabel eri yaper tete wos omotek, agetagewai yabel ere neirkap teketete, lup te beke kip pas.
Sow eme nelke tetan, eme yesen yeirkwutete. Nina ere nelke yate, nelri wos eme birbetan kenakena yite.
Etep tementek, sene eme late, agetage Tatame Etemne Lan Yeirim Tame, an yate. An nel geike yate. An mureken tamekap yate, an keryenkap yate.
Yatek, an God eri kom tame emne won yite, eme you yale ekte ekte eme etek yite, eme God eri kiyi kenem tatame emne akei panen yan wurisubuk site.
Kwar kepken mok walkuken yabe sekur sakur tuma.
Metye. Kem kwar kepken mok walkuken abote. Kwar kepken mok walkuken yeirbe, kem etep wobe. Nabe tete nenbe.
Ari kiyi wom tuma e etepkap, kem etep abote. Ari yate yabel mekin mekinye.
An kemne sekenke wobe. Gwopte tetan tatame eme mak samente, ari kiyi woye wos eme kir late nenbe.
Nelken selken akei omote nenbe. Areri tumawou e som temente nenbe.
Eike tatame eme ete wos tete yabel beke met.
Aren sene yate yabel tatame eme beke met. God eteri komri tame eme etepwou beke met. Aren, an God Eteri Yen, aren etepwou an beke met. God eterwou ere metten.
Kem beke met, be yabelke an sene yate, eke kem eisa eisa. Kem noub lakerete.

Ete yabel ere gwopkap. Keryen ere kom mesginin gene komke yim. Yite womke, ere yaku kerebetem tame emne yaku petera sewuren emne etep wom. Kem wos lakerebetete. Etep wom, ere ake eru lakerebetem tame erne etep wom. Ne ake eru noub lakerete. Etep won, ere mesginin yim.

Jisas ere etep wom. An ete keryen eterkap. Be yabelke ake maime ere sene yate, kem beke met. Yabel wartek ere yate, o neir borke ere yate, o kwokwo wobetetek ere yate, o ei berabetetek ere yate o? Etepkap kem eyar noub lakerete.
Ere kemne agetage yan late, kem mane tuknamente.
An kemne wobe tumakap, an tatame nogwape emne wobe. An etep wobe. Aren yate yabel kem noub lakerete. Ere etep wom.
